messages:
marco: Addressed the comments on PR #4823 — PTAL when you have a minute. Fixed kv allocator rotation + added a small integration smoke. CI was green locally but flaky in the CI run.

tara: Thanks — I'll take a look today. which commit has the squashed changes?

marco: Pushed squashed commit `a1b2c3d` and force-pushed to the branch. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4823/files

jules: Quick pass — looks good overall. Left a tiny nit about the allocator log level (debug -> info). Also we should add a short comment in allocator.go explaining the rotation edge case.

marco: Good catch, addressed both nits and pushed. Added a one-line comment in allocator.go and reduced log to info.

ci-bot: Build started for branch fix/kv-alloc-rotation (workflow: unit-tests)

ci-bot: Build failed — unit-tests (kv_allocator_test) flaky failure. Log: ```FAIL kv_allocator_test.go:128: expected 4 free pages, got 3``` 

sam: I can triage the flaky test later today. If this is blocking the merge window, we can canary the change behind the allocator feature flag — it's not user-visible.

marco: Prefer merge before EOD if possible. The change is low-risk; canary seems fine. @oncall: FYI if we can run a short canary once CI passes.

yvonne: PTAL — I gave an approve after confirming the comment and log change. 

tara: Approved as well. If CI passes on the next run, feel free to merge and schedule a canary rollout.

jules: LGTM, approving now. :thumbsup:

marco: Thanks everyone — rerunning CI. Will merge once we get a green from unit-tests and then start a small canary (10% of traffic) for 2 hours.

ci-bot: Build started (re-run)

ci-bot: Build succeeded — all checks green.

marco: Merged and kicked off canary. Will post an update if anything odd shows up. Thanks all!
